drac.translation: abbr. 动态转发授权控制（软件名, Dynamic Relay Authorization Control）；动态资源分配控制（Dynamic Resource Allocation Control）；戴尔公司的一种系统管理硬件和软件解决方案（Dell Remote Access Controller）；救灾咨询委员会（救灾咨询委员会）

dracaena.definition: n an agave that is often cultivated for its decorative foliage

dracaenaceae.translation: [网络] 龙血树科；虎尾兰科；独立成一个科

drach.translation: abbr. drachma 德拉克马（希腊货币单位）

drachm.definition:
n a unit of apothecary weight equal to an eighth of an ounce or to 60 grains
n a British imperial capacity measure (liquid or dry) equal to 60 minims or 3.5516 cubic centimeters
n a unit of capacity or volume in the apothecary system equal to one eighth of a fluid ounce
drachm.translation: n. 古希腊的银币名, 古希腊的重量单位

drachma.definition: n. formerly the basic unit of money in Greece

drachmae.translation: n. 古希腊的重量单位；古希腊的银币名 (drachma的变形)

drachmas.translation: n. 古希腊的银币名, 古希腊的重量单位( drachma的名词复数 )

draco.definition:
n. Athenian lawmaker whose code of laws prescribed death for almost every offense (circa 7th century BC)
n. a faint constellation twisting around the north celestial pole and lying between Ursa Major and Cepheus
n. a reptile genus known as flying dragons or flying lizards

dracocephalum.translation: [网络] 青兰属；青兰输；青蓝属

dracone.translation: n. [船]弹性拖曳容器,(装石油的)橡胶(或尼龙)袋

draconian.definition: a. of or relating to Draco or his harsh code of laws
draconian.translation: a. 严厉的, 残酷的

draconic.definition:
a. Relating to Draco, the Athenian lawgiver; or to the
   constellation Draco; or to dragon's blood.

dracontium.definition: n any plant of the genus Dracontium; strongly malodorous tropical American plants usually with gigantic leaves

dracontologist.translation: n. 研究湖中巨型生物是否存在的人, 湖怪研究者

dracula.definition:
n. comprises tropical American species usually placed in genus Masdevallia: diminutive plants having bizarre and often sinister-looking flowers with pendulous scapes and motile lips
n. fictional vampire in a gothic horror novel by Bram Stoker
dracula.translation: n. 德拉库拉（人名）；吸血鬼, 又叫惊情四百年（电影名）

dracula sneeze.definition:
holding your arm up over your face in a position similar to Dracula holding up his cape and then sneezing into you elbow
> Do to the H1N1 swine flu pandemic the Centers For Disease Control recommends using the Dracula sneeze technique to avoid spreading germs.

dracunculiasis.definition: n a painful and debilitating infestation contracted by drinking stagnant water contaminated with Guinea worm larvae that can mature inside a human's abdomen until the worm emerges through a painful blister in the person's skin

dracunculus.definition:
n tuberous herbaceous perennials: dragon arum
n type genus of the family Dracunculidae

dracunculus loa.translation: [医] 罗阿龙线虫, 罗阿丝虫

dracunculus oculi.translation: [医] 眼龙线虫, 眼丝虫

dracunculus vulgaris.translation: [网络] 伏都百合；巨型魔芋
